core_concept: Premium AI Intelligence, Minimal, High-end. Avoid heavy military styling. Clean AI technology look.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for marketing sections. Use gap-6, gap-8 for bento grids.

grid.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetric bento grids.
grid.dashboard_demo: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Dense 'Control Room' grid for the multi-panel demo interface.

layout.radius: rounded-none or max 8px (rounded-md) for sharp, technical AI aesthetic.

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 hover:bg-cyan-400 font-medium tracking-wide transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(6,182,212,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 hover:border-cyan-500/50 hover:text-cyan-400 bg-transparent text-white transition-all

cards.marketing: bg-[#0F172A] border border-white/5 hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all p-8
cards.demo_panels: bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 p-4 flex flex-col h-full

components.inputs: bg-slate-900/50 border border-white/10 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500/50 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500

interactions.hover: Subtle border color shifts to cyan, soft glows. Text shifts to white or cyan-400.
interactions.demo_animations: Use framer-motion for smooth text-based narration transitions. Elements should fade in with a slight upward translation.

media.instructions: Use exact provided URLs. Apply bg-black/40 overlay on hero images if needed for text contrast.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark blue grid for main homepage hero background
Business professionals negotiating, used as the main video/scenario screen in the demo page
Facial recognition biometric eye scan used for the Forensic Visual Library product page cover
Neon cyan abstract art to use as decorative background element for training cards

pages_structure.Home: Hero with full viewport height, dark blue background, bold Outfit typography. 2 CTAs. Sections for explanation and training intros.
pages_structure.Demo: Multi-panel dashboard style. Left/center: Scenario Video (Image). Right/Bottom panels: Signal Interpretation (Visual, Auditory, Behavioral bars/gauges), Pattern Recognition, Strategy Output. Bottom/Side: Text-based narration panel stepping through the analysis.
pages_structure.Training: Split layout showing Signal Foundations ($400) and Applied Signals ($1500). High contrast cyan buttons linked to Stripe.
pages_structure.Forensic Library: Product marketing page. 50/50 layout. Left side text/value prop, right side biometric scan image.
pages_structure.Contact: Clean form over dark glass surface.
pages_structure.Admin: Strict control room grid. Full width table for leads. Export CSV button top right.

icons: lucide-react, tailored with cyan or slate coloring.
testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
